dedupe_keys.name: usda agricultural transportation open data platform agtransport

description: AgTransport is the USDA's open data platform on the transport of agricultural goods. It publishes datasets and dashboards on barge, rail, truck, ocean and container transport of grain, oilseeds, fertilizer and biofuels: Mississippi River System and Pacific Northwest grain barge rates, barge movements of grain and upbound fertilizer, rail tariff rates for grain, soybean meal and fertilizer, carloads by railroad and cars not moved in over 48 hours, rail shipment sizes and distances, quarterly grain truck rates, top container ports for agricultural trade, ethanol carloads, anhydrous ammonia pipeline tariffs, the economic importance of inland waterways to US agriculture, and transport and landed costs for Brazilian and Ukrainian grain exports. Many series are updated weekly or monthly; several were updated in September 2026. Coverage is mainly the United States, with export corridors from Brazil and Ukraine. Access: free on a Socrata platform with web views, dashboards, CSV and JSON exports and an API. Caveats: no licence is stated in the metadata read, and many series are prices and aggregates, not network or asset data. It supports freight flow and supply chain disruption analysis for agriculture, inland waterway and rail capacity studies (for example during low water on the Mississippi) and calibration of freight models, and complements the USACE waterborne commerce and STB waybill records catalogued here.
